Analysis:
The error indicates that pom.xml has `<exec.mainClass>com.example.QpidAmqpApp</exec.mainClass>` but the actual main class is `com.example.ProtocolApplication`. This mismatch will cause Maven exec to fail because it cannot find a class named `QpidAmqpApp`. The fix is to change the main class property in pom.xml to match the actual application entry point, which is `com.example.ProtocolApplication`.

<<<KRIYA:EDIT path="pom.xml">>>
<<<KRIYA:SEARCH>>>
    <properties>
        <maven.compiler.source>17</maven.compiler.source>
        <maven.compiler.target>17</maven.compiler.target>
        <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>
        <exec.mainClass>com.example.QpidAmqpApp</exec.mainClass>
    </properties>
<<<KRIYA:REPLACE>>>
    <properties>
        <maven.compiler.source>17</maven.compiler.source>
        <maven.compiler.target>17</maven.compiler.target>
        <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>
        <exec.mainClass>com.example.ProtocolApplication</exec.mainClass>
    </properties>
<<<KRIYA:END_EDIT>>>
<<<KRIYA:FILE path="pom.xml">>>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0
                             http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <groupId>com.example</groupId>
    <artifactId>qpid-amqp-app</artifactId>
    <version>1.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
    <packaging>jar</packaging>

    <name>Qpid AMQP Application</name>
    <description>Embedded Qpid Broker-J with JMS client using Jakarta Messaging 3.1 API</description>

    <properties>
        <maven.compiler.source>17</maven.compiler.source>
        <maven.compiler.target>17</maven.compiler.target>
        <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>
        <exec.mainClass>com.example.ProtocolApplication</exec.mainClass>
    </properties>

    <dependencies>
        <!-- Embedded broker -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.apache.qpid</groupId>
            <artifactId>qpid-broker-core</artifactId>
            <version>9.2.1</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.apache.qpid</groupId>
            <artifactId>qpid-broker-plugins-amqp-1-0-protocol</artifactId>
            <version>9.2.1</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.apache.qpid</groupId>
            <artifactId>qpid-broker-plugins-memory-store</artifactId>
            <version>9.2.1</version>
        </dependency>

        <!-- JMS client (Jakarta Messaging 3.1 API) -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.apache.qpid</groupId>
            <artifactId>qpid-jms-client</artifactId>
            <version>2.10.0</version>
        </dependency>

        <!-- JUnit for testing -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
            <artifactId>junit-jupiter</artifactId>
            <version>5.9.2</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>

    <build>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.codehaus.mojo</groupId>
                <artifactId>exec-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.1.0</version>
                <configuration>
                    <executable>java</executable>
                    <arguments>
                        <!-- Required for Qpid broker embedding on JDK 17.0.10+ -->
                        <argument>-Djava.security.manager=allow</argument>
                        <argument>-classpath</argument>
                        <classpath/>
                        <argument>${exec.mainClass}</argument>
                    </arguments>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
</project>
<<<KRIYA:END_FILE>>>
